title: Encoding of cerebellar dentate neuron activity during visual attention in rhesus macaques
primary_outputs: Cerebellar dentate neuron encoding of attention/task variables with trial-level GLMs.
Neural prediction of behavioral outcomes and history effects, using alternative regularization and trial-block validation.
